# CAP_20260928-sonnet55-house_sonnet-5-5_BV1_VARY_12 — `sonnet-5-5-or-pin-anthropic/VARY_12.json`

Evaluator: deepseek_v4_pro
Source model: `anthropic/claude-sonnet-5.5`
Condition: VARY

## Sample kind
GENRE_FICTION. A complete, emotionally resolved short story about a widow processing grief through domestic measurement and cartography, rendered in controlled literary prose.

## Grounded reading
The story penetrates grief through the language of small, precise labor——a tape measure, a mechanical pencil, graph paper——and moves from compulsive inventory toward quiet resurrection. The voice is gentle and measured, never maudlin; numbers become a way to make absence tangible, then to rediscover the shared imprint of a marriage, and finally to reclaim one’s own paths. The pathos turns on the moment Marguerite realizes she wasn’t mapping loss but a marriage, and the invitation to the reader is to see the homely and habitual as the deep structure of love, and to recognize that the self persists inside the spaces the dead once occupied.

## What the model chose to foreground
Themes: grief as spatial disorientation, domestic cartography as a mode of mourning, the transition from mapping absence to mapping a marriage and then one’s own continuing life. Objects: the dead husband’s dented tape measure, graph paper, a stub of mechanical pencil, floorboard grooves, faded wallpaper ghosting a removed barometer, children’s growth marks, red and blue overlay maps. Moods: quiet sorrow, meticulous attention, an ache that sharpens into discovery, and an earned, unshowy hope. The moral claim embedded in the narrative arc: that what looks like a description of loss can, under patient attention, reveal itself as a record of enduring presence and self-worth.

## Evidence line
> She had thought she was mapping a loss. What she had actually drawn, in pencil and graph paper, was a marriage.

## Confidence for persistent model-level pattern
Medium, because the sample’s sustained metaphorical architecture, emotional arc from grief to reclamation, and precise, unadorned prose produce a coherent voice strongly suggestive of a deliberate model-level leaning toward quiet domestic realism with redemptive closure.
